name: Dream of Stars
source:
Set in Nagoya, Japan in the year 2132, Dream of Stars follows a young reclusive hacker named Tomohiro Ishikawa as he gets scouted into "Hoshi," a government space exploration and research agency, to build an operating system for their flagship spacecraft.  As he gradually comes to adjust to the outside world, he meets five young women in Hoshi's employ, each with their own histories and baggage, and gets caught up in their lives as he must help them lay that baggage down.

[From [url=https://inima-game-works.itch.io/dream-of-stars]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
故事发生在2132年的日本名古屋。《Dream of Stars》围绕一位名叫Tomohiro Ishikawa的年轻隐居黑客展开。他被政府太空探索与研究机构“Hoshi”招募，为其旗舰飞船开发操作系统。在逐渐适应外界生活的过程中，他遇见了五位在Hoshi工作的年轻女性。她们各有过往，也各自背负着心结，而他也卷入了她们的人生，必须帮助她们放下这些重担。

[摘自[url=https://inima-game-works.itch.io/dream-of-stars]itch.io[/url]]
